newsitem.title: ROMANIA: France Telecom to launch Romania second GSM.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom to launch Romania second GSM.

text.p: A consortium led by France Telecom will launch Romania's second GSM mobile telephone system in June, an executive said on Monday.
"Our GSM system will become operational on June 6," Andrei Chirica, director at the Mobil Rom consortium, told reporters.

Chirica said Mobil Rom, which operates under the brand name of Dialog, had planned a fast roll-out of the project and hoped to cover Romania's main cities and roads and get some 25,000 subscribers by the end of this year.
When operational, Dialog would be the second GSM system available in Romania, the last country in the region to set up such a digital telephony system.

Last December, Mobil Rom won one of the two licences offered in a tender by the Communications Ministry. The other winner was the Mobifon consortium led by Telesystem International Wireless (TIWC) of Canada.
Mobifon launched the country's first GSM system under the brand name of Connex GSM last week.
Connex executives told Reuters on Monday sales had "so far exceeded expectations", without supplying a figure.
Connex plans to attract over one million subscribers by 2005. Dialog's target amounts to some 800,000.
Each consortium plans to spend around $500 million to implement and upgrade its projects over the next 10 years.
Analysts see Romania as a good market for communications. Some 3.1 million of its 23 million people subscribe to the fixed network, a penetration rate of only 13 percent, one of the lowest in Europe.

Mobil Rom groups Alcatel Network Systems Romania, a branch of Alcatel, Romanian private computer retailer ComputerLand and the MediaPro media group. Tomen Telecom Romania, a subsidiary of Tomen Corp of Japan, is also part of the consortium.
